regions.finding: Confirmed the actual article title and that cited transition-metal/radical/earlier EATA work is background literature, not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Scheme 1 reaction header, all amine rows, and caption
regions.finding: Nineteen independent amine/time conditions were retained, including three separate (S)-3h time points, signed −99%/−94% ee source values, slash ee markers, and two no-desired-product outcomes. Shared 1a/2a/amine/CuBr2/CuCl/dioxane/80 °C/argon quantities and NMR/HPLC measurement bases were applied to each displayed line.
The article states ESI availability and CCDC 2039513, but source_mapping.json leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

unresolved: Workup, purification, isolated masses, and exact structures for several amine variants are absent from pages 1–5.
Signed ee values may imply the opposite major enantiomer from the Scheme 1 header product; no configuration was inferred.

regions.finding: Narrative results were reconciled with page-1 rows rather than duplicated; the 79%/3 h 3h result is one of the three displayed time points.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–16, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Sixteen independent catalyst/solvent rows were retained with row-specific catalyst omissions, temperatures, time, 4bb NMR yield/ee, and 5bb yield. Entry 1 uses the printed 1.0 mmol (S)-3a/6 h override; entry 16 keeps only explicitly printed absolute values.
The prose calls the 32% product 4aa, whereas the table header and reaction drawing show 4bb. The table/drawing assignment was retained and the conflict logged.
Scope prose previews Scheme 2/3 but supplies no additional independent arrows beyond the page-3 scheme entries.

unresolved: Entry 1 contains a printed 1.0 mmol 3a loading that conflicts with the shared small-scale stoichiometry.
Entry 1 product is labeled 4aa in prose versus 4bb in the table/drawing.
Entry 16 omits explicit absolute 1b/2b amounts; they were not arithmetically inferred.
Workup, purification, and isolated masses are absent.

regions.region: page 3 upper full-width Scheme 2 terminal-alkyne scope and late-stage modification
regions.finding: Thirty-six distinct arrow/condition lines were retained, including opposite-catalyst enantiomer runs, 2q amount override, doubled-allenation conditions, the separate 4aq-to-mesomer second stage, late-stage substrates, and the 31% source-labeled intermediate beside 4aw.
Eighteen independent (S)-3h or (R)-3h runs were retained with row-specific time, yield, and ee for nine substrate/product pairs.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 captions/footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Shared reagent amounts, catalyst loadings, MTBE volume, 70 °C, and argon were structured; all explicit footnote overrides entered participant amounts rather than notes alone.
The A3 coupling/1,5-H transfer/beta-N-elimination sequence and DFT comparison were classified as mechanism/computation records, not reported bench experiments.

unresolved: Scheme-only scope entries omit workup, purification, isolated masses, and explicit yield basis.
4ax and 4av machine/source stereochemical identifiers conflict; source labels are retained while structures remain unverified.
The 4aw intermediate is labeled only 'int' and its structure/basis are not specified.

regions.finding: Generic A3 coupling, 1,5-H transfer, and beta-N-elimination pathway was recorded as a plausible mechanism; its intermediates are not isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 4 upper half Figure 1b and adjacent DFT text
regions.finding: Both non-TMS and TMS relative-energy profiles, source energy values, coordination distances, and the stated barrier reduction were retained as computational claims, not reaction yields.
ESI is mentioned but not associated in source_mapping.json. CCDC 2039513 is characterization of 4ax, not a new experiment or machine-structure verification.
Reproduced results for (Ra)-4aa, (Sa)-4ai, and (Ra)-4ca were linked as provenance to existing scope records because no independent run details are supplied.

unresolved: DFT values were not independently recalculated.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not define separable runs.
CCDC data do not verify candidate SMILES.

regions.finding: Bibliography and cited prior work only; external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.
The crystallographic deposition characterizes 4ax. It was linked to the existing 4ax record and was not treated as a reaction or as an explicitly associated SI file.

unresolved: No new experimental operation or yield is reported on this references page.
CCDC 2039513 does not establish semantic accuracy or verify the machine structure encoding.
